import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static int n, t, sx, sy;
    static int[][] temp = new int[11][11];
    static boolean[][] m = new boolean[11][11];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g;
    static ArrayList<Edge> e;
    static int[] d, ptr;

    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;
        Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge(a, b, cap, 0);
        Edge e2 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0);
        g[a].add(e.size());
        e.add(e1);
        g[b].add(e.size());
        e.add(e2);
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(0);
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[0] = 0;
        int sink = n * n * 2 + 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && d[sink] == -1) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int id : g[v]) {
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (d[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                    q.add(to);
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return d[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        int sink = n * n * 2 + 1;
        if (v == sink) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ++ptr[v]) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.get(id).b;
            if (d[to] != d[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(0, INF);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static int way(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, x1, y1});
        int[][] h = new int[11][11];
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(h[i], INF);

        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            if (h[x][y] <= v) continue;
            h[x][y] = v;

            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; ++dir) {
                int nx = x + dx[dir];
                int ny = y + dy[dir];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (!m[nx][ny]) continue;
                if (h[nx][ny] <= v + 1) continue;
                boolean target = (nx == x2 && ny == y2);
                int lim = temp[nx][ny];
                if ((target && lim >= v + 1) || (!target && lim > v + 1))
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, nx, ny});
            }
        }
        return h[x2][y2];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        int totalNodes = n * n * 2 + 2;
        g = new ArrayList[totalNodes];
        for (int i = 0; i < totalNodes; ++i)
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        e = new ArrayList<>();
        d = new int[totalNodes];
        ptr = new int[totalNodes];

        // Initialize temp and m
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(temp[i], t);
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(m[i], false);

        // Read first grid
        int k = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                temp[i][j] = t;
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else if (ch == 'Y') {
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    m[i][j] = true;
                }
                int cap = (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0';
                add_edge(0, k, cap);
                k++;
            }
        }

        // Read second grid
        k = n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int cap = (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y') ? 0 : ch - '0';
                add_edge(k, n * n * 2 + 1, cap);
                k++;
            }
        }

        // BFS from start to compute temp (earliest arrival times)
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, sx, sy});
        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int v = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            if (temp[x][y] <= v) continue;
            temp[x][y] = v;
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; ++dir) {
                int nx = x + dx[dir];
                int ny = y + dy[dir];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (v + 1 < temp[nx][ny] && m[nx][ny])
                    q.add(new int[]{v + 1, nx, ny});
            }
        }

        // Add edges between first and second grid cells
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int node1 = i * n + j + 1;
                for (int z = 0; z < n; ++z) {
                    for (int w = 0; w < n; ++w) {
                        int node2 = n * n + z * n + w + 1;
                        if (m[i][j] && m[z][w] && way(i, j, z, w) <= t)
                            add_edge(node1, node2, INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(max_flow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
